jobInfo:
Join the Fastest Growing Fast Food Chain in the Country


Softlogic Restaurants (Pvt) Ltd, a fully owned subsidiary of Softlogic Holdings PLC, opened with a franchise signed with the US chain under Burger King Asia Pacific Private Ltd, BURGER KING, the world's second largest hamburger chain that serves over 11 million guests per day across 91 nations. With the recent acquisition of BASKIN ROBBINS, the world's largest chain of ice cream and DELIFRANCE which serves "French style" baked products, Softlogic Restaurants (Pvt) Ltd has become the fastest growing chain of restaurants in the country. Furthermore, CRYSTAL JADE, a Singaporean chain of restaurant, that operates under Micheline Star grade, too is a part of our chain of restaurants and the newest Fast Food restaurant venture is POPEYES. We are looking for a talented, competent team worker for the below mentioned designation.


Shift Manager / Supervisor | Colombo & Kandy

jobItem.overview: Do you have minimum 1-year experience as a supervisor in International Fast Food Restaurant Chain? Please refer to the job advert for further information.
jobItem.locations: Colombo, Western Province; Kandy, Central Province
